values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753472 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0', 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a toilet (type not stated), primitive campsites and a concrete boat ramp; no drinking water listed. Accessibility rated 'Easy'.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753472 (Facilities: 'Ramp (Concrete)', 'Toilet', 'Primitive Campsite'; ADA Accessibility 'Easy Accessibility'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site (16 acres, ~3,850 ft) on the Missouri River with designated primitive camping (Region 3). Directions (FWP): 4 miles south of Townsend on Hwy 287 to mile marker 82, turn right onto access road, cross rail road tracks, then to river. No trailer length limit published by FWP. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page: confirmed $12/$18 FAS camping, toilet, primitive campsites, concrete ramp. Not stated: site count, trailer length, stay limit, toilet type, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left), real season (the 'Open 2011-01-01 to 2011-12-31' placeholder only; stored manual year_round left). No notices or closures. Note trimmed of restated facilities/fees/FCFS.
